criteria.text: The mobile client's SSE consumer streams on native platforms: gateway-shaped frames (including projectless desktop events whose directory is the pseudonymous project id) cross the client parse boundary, split chunks reassemble, non-streaming responses fail loudly instead of hanging.
While a desktop-originated projectless chat is open on the physical iPhone, desktop user and assistant turns appear automatically without refresh, and mobile turns appear live on desktop.
criteria.test_id: physical-device smoke with Metro boundary diagnostics
